epic.summary: Meeting Transcription Tool (MTT, a.k.a. AI Meeting notes) transforming from POC to prod & refactoring

ai.s: Adds a "My Notes" screen to the mobile app so attendees and exhibitors can review, edit, copy and delete all their meeting notes in one place.
ai.pr: Meeting notes could only be reached meeting by meeting, so users had no single place to review or manage everything they had written.
ai.wy: Second part of the Personalized Meeting Notes feature within the AI Meeting Notes (MTT) move from proof of concept to production.
ai.oc: A My Notes list, reached from My Schedule's overflow menu, shows each noted meeting with a note snippet and Edit, Copy, Delete and Go to meeting actions on iOS and Android.

summary: Extend Claude Code usage with skills, agents, hooks, rules etc

ai.s: Extends the team's Claude Code set-up with new rules, hooks, agents and skills to improve the quality of AI-generated solutions.
ai.pr: The team's Claude Code usage relied on a basic set-up without the rules, hooks, agents and skills that could improve generated code.
ai.wy: Internal efficiency: better AI tooling should raise the quality of AI-assisted frontend development.
ai.oc: Research into available Claude Code extensions (with reference resources listed) to find and add features to the team's set-up; no delivered result is recorded.

summary: Enable Luquid glass for iOS app

ai.s: Enables Apple's Liquid Glass design language in the iOS app so native navigation, tab bars and modals look right on iOS 26.
ai.pr: iOS 26 introduced the translucent Liquid Glass material, and the app had not been opted in or audited, risking inconsistent or broken visuals on key screens.
ai.wy: Tech debt: keep the iOS app current with Apple's platform design changes without regressing older iOS versions.
ai.oc: Liquid Glass enabled for iOS 26+, with a visual audit of dashboard, navigation, modals, lists and custom components, fixes for issues found and screenshots as evidence.

summary: [TechDept] Potential bug: if an exhibitor removes the equipment in status cancelled from the cart

ai.s: Fixes cancelled equipment remaining in the exhibitor cart, so a later re-approved payment cannot mark removed equipment as purchased.
ai.pr: After a payment was cancelled, its equipment moved to 'Cancelled' but still showed in the cart; if the exhibitor removed it and the payment was re-approved, equipment with no record in manuals_equipments counted as purchased.
ai.wy: Tech debt found after the payment-cancellation change; it prevents inconsistent order data in the Exhibitor Manual.
ai.oc: Cart and payment logic to be corrected so cancelled equipment is handled consistently and cannot become an orphaned 'purchased' item.

summary: Remove legacy "bm" database from the codebase

ai.s: Removes all code that reads from or writes to the legacy "bm" Business Matching PostgreSQL database, cutting dead integration code from the platform.
ai.pr: The application still synced data into a separate "bm" database for an external Business Matching engine, leaving tasks, models, trait methods and provider registrations that were no longer needed.
ai.wy: Technical debt reduction: retire a legacy data store and its maintenance cost; continues the clean-up started in EP-47347.
ai.oc: A prioritised removal plan covering BmTask, the 16 BM models, ExhibitorsTrait methods, controller calls and the bm/bm_replica provider registrations; DynamoDB-based BM results stay out of scope.

ai.s: Adds a V3 POST endpoint to create event accounts, splitting account creation out of the combined V2 /account/set call.
ai.pr: In V2, /api/v2/account/set handled both creating and updating accounts in one endpoint, with no clean REST-style create call.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, giving integrators a modern, consistent API.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts specified with required and optional fields, photo upload or URL, validations and a standard response envelope; updates move to a separate PUT.

ai.s: Moves the account token-check endpoint to V3 so integrators can validate a Bearer token for an event under the accounts resource.
ai.pr: Token validation lived at /api/v2/account/checkToken, outside the event-scoped resource structure and response format the V3 API uses.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration to standardise authentication and responses.
ai.oc: GET /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts/checkToken returns validity, account, event and expiry, with standard Bearer auth, the {code, data, errors} envelope and ISO 8601 dates.

ai.s: Migrates the account deleteSessions endpoint to the Public API V3.
ai.pr: The /api/v2/account/deleteSessions endpoint existed only in the V2 API.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 endpoint migration.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; a V3 equivalent of deleteSessions is expected.

ai.s: Adds a V3 endpoint that adds one or more sessions to an account's My Schedule, replacing V2 setSessions.
ai.pr: Adding sessions to an attendee's personal schedule via the API relied on the V2 /api/v2/account/setSessions endpoint.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, modelling the schedule as a calendar sub-resource.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts/{accountId}/calendar takes a sessionIds array, validates every ID before writing and rejects invalid input with a clear 422 error.

ai.s: Migrates the bulk account deletion endpoint to the Public API V3.
ai.pr: The /api/v2/account/deleteBulk endpoint existed only in the V2 API.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 endpoint migration.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; a V3 equivalent of deleteBulk is expected.

ai.s: Migrates the account setCategory endpoint to the Public API V3.

ai.s: Adds a V3 endpoint listing accounts deleted from an event, so integrations can sync removals incrementally.
ai.pr: Integrations needing to detect removed participants relied on the V2 /api/v2/participants/{eventId}/deletedList endpoint.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration; supports integration sync flows.
ai.oc: GET /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts/deleted returns a paginated list of deleted accounts, with an optional timestamp filter for incremental sync.

ai.s: Adds a V3 endpoint returning an account's full event profile, including custom questions, with lookup by ID, external ID or email.
ai.pr: Account profiles were retrieved through V2 /api/v2/account/get, without the V3 path structure and nested response format.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, giving integrators a consistent structured response.
ai.oc: GET /api/v3/events/{eventId}/accounts/{accountId} specified with filter options, x-lang support, a customQuestions array and standard error responses.

ai.s: Migrates the event delete endpoint to the Public API V3.

ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 endpoint migration.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; a V3 equivalent of event delete is expected.

ai.s: Adds a V3 POST endpoint to create events, with optional cloning of settings, template and exhibitors from an existing event.
ai.pr: In V2, /api/v2/event/set handled both creating and updating events in one endpoint.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/events specified with required title, country, city, start and end, optional venue fields and cloneEventId, validated before anything is written.

ai.s: Adds a V3 POST endpoint to create exhibitors, splitting creation out of the combined V2 /exhibitor/set call.
ai.pr: In V2, /api/v2/exhibitor/set handled both creating and updating exhibitors in one endpoint.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration to give integrators a modern, consistent API.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/events/{eventId}/exhibitors specified with profile, contact, password and image fields plus validations; updates move to a separate PUT.

ai.s: Adds a V3 endpoint returning an exhibitor's full event profile with structured country, city, hall, stand and custom field data.
ai.pr: Exhibitor profiles were retrieved through V2 /api/v2/exhibitor/get, without the V3 path structure and nested objects.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, giving integrators a consistent structured response.
ai.oc: GET /api/v3/events/{eventId}/exhibitors/{exhibitorId} specified with lookup by ID or external ID, x-lang support and standard error responses.

ai.s: Adds a V3 endpoint to delete an exhibitor from an event by ID, with cascade clean-up and visibility in the deleted-exhibitors feed.

ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration; supports integration sync flows.
ai.oc: DELETE /api/v3/events/{eventId}/exhibitors/{exhibitorId} removes the exhibitor, cleans up stands, products and team links and lists it in the deleted endpoint (EP-51410).

ai.s: Adds a V3 POST endpoint to create stands within a floor plan hall, including conference, check-in and buyer lounge flags.
ai.pr: In V2, /api/v2/floorplan/setStand handled both creating and updating stands in one endpoint.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/floorplan/halls/{hallId}/stands specified with name and zone flags, returning 201 with the new stand; updates move to a separate PUT.
